notes.message: Title, Description: the exported parts (AlertTitle, AlertDescription), each a FRAME under Alert in source order, whatever nesting a consumer gives them. Of each part only its direction (a flex part's own, else a column), its width and height (its own width or height utility; else fill where Alert stretches it, hug otherwise) are read, and its visibility where Alert styles its presence (a Slot axis). Its own layout, paint and text are not drafted yet.
AlertAction (components/ui/alert.tsx:65): position absolute (absolute) takes it out of the flow Auto Layout lays out, so the anatomy leaves it out.
No border-color utility colours Alert's border, so it takes its colour from app/globals.css's base layer: * { border-color: var(--border) }.
has-[>svg]:gap-x-2, has-[>svg]:grid-cols-[auto_1fr]: Styled by what the component holds, in a :has() form other than :has([attr="value"]), the only one read as a Slot axis (#121). Not carried.
has-data-[slot=alert-action]:pr-18, has-data-[slot=alert-action]:relative: Styled by whether the component holds a part the anatomy leaves out (see the anatomy notes). Not carried.

*:[svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4, *:[svg]:row-span-2, *:[svg]:text-current, *:[svg]:translate-y-0.5, *:data-[slot=alert-description]:text-destructive/90, group/alert: Styled by an ancestor; that is a Mode or the parent's Contract (ADR 0012). Not carried.
text-card-foreground, text-destructive, text-left, text-sm: Text utilities; text styles, the label and the anatomy beyond the root are not drafted yet (agent tier). Not carried.
relative: No Contract field carries these properties. Not carried.
